__STUB__
Sudden hanabi chrysanthemum-burst high overhead, gold-pink petals of light washing her upturned face warm-amber.
Paper-lanterns rising in deep midground sky, dozens at once dotting the night, her smile catching their glow.
Warm summer-rain starting on hanabi-sky, first drops glinting on chochin-lanterns strung above her head.
Shooting-star streaking across midground sky above the festival, single white arc vanishing as she reaches for candied-apple.
Handful of sparklers lit simultaneously at midground by laughing friend-group, gold sparks raining across the lane.
Mask-vendor pulling cloth-cover off fresh batch of kitsune-masks at midground stall, fox-faces gleaming under lantern-light.
Mikoshi portable-shrine carried past at midground, rope-bearers chanting, gold-lacquer flash rippling through festival crowd.
Festival-master lighting central yagura-lantern at midground, warm-amber bloom spreading outward across the square.
Paper-confetti showering from midground rooftop, pastel-streamers spiraling down through chochin-lit air around her.
Taiko-drummer mid-strike at midground yagura-platform, bachi-stick arcing high, drum-boom felt more than heard.
Cascade-firework dripping willow-style at midground sky, golden threads descending slow behind her cotton-candy cloud.
Single river-lantern floating past at midground waterline, amber reflection trembling on dark current beside her feet.
Triple-burst fireworks overlapping at midground sky, pink-white-gold chrysanthemums blooming simultaneously overhead.
Meteor-streak distant across deep midground, faint silver arc above the yatai-row smoke and colored lights.
Pyrotechnic-fountain at festival-stage midground erupting, white cascade of sparks arcing over the crowd behind her.
Lantern-string lighting up sequentially along yatai-row, warm-amber pulse traveling stall to stall in the background.
Drizzle beginning at midground, chochin-lanterns haloed with fine mist, rain-dots freckling the stone path.
First-star appearing as dusk deepens above the festival, single point of light piercing violet sky at midground.
New mask-stall opening at midground, vendor flipping sign and arranging tanuki-faces under fresh lantern-light.
Cascade of sparks from midground yagura-tower corner, pyrotechnic-burst raining copper-gold across the festival lane.
Festival-float cart rolling past at midground, paper-flower garlands swaying, drum-rhythm pulsing through the ground.
Chochin-string lighting up sequentially from midground to foreground, warm-amber bloom reaching toward her face.
First drops of summer-rain on hanabi-sky, each drop catching neon-pink burst-light above the festival.
Dozen paper-lanterns released simultaneously at midground sky, amber constellation rising slow into the deep violet night.
